# Release 1.22 — Watchlists & morning inbox

**Status:** Outline — freeze when 1.21 ships  
**Milestone:** `1.22`  
**Parent strategy:** [Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap_v1.2.md](../Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap_v1.2.md)  
**Architecture source of truth:** [../superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-wealth-orbit-architecture-evaluation-design.md](../superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-wealth-orbit-architecture-evaluation-design.md)  
**Rule:** Do not edit this file to mark done or change scope after `Approved for freeze`. Status → GitHub only.

---

## Outcome

Signed-in users can maintain **watchlists** of stocks and/or funds and use **Home as a morning decision inbox** (~5 minutes): portfolio attention (MTM when 1.11 exists), watchlist movers/staleness, failed syncs, and later stance flips (once 1.23–1.24 exist). React becomes the **only** daily portfolio import/entry path for this loop (Streamlit import capability is ported or replaced — Streamlit is not required for morning use).

This release does **not** invent buy/hold/avoid labels (that is 1.23+). It may show placeholders for “stance” only if 1.23 already shipped; otherwise omit stance rows.

---

## Locked decisions

| Decision | Choice | Agent implication |
|----------|--------|-------------------|
| Daily loops | Morning check is first-class | Home is not only index tiles |
| Audience | Beginner + experienced | Beginner: simple attention list; experienced: stale sync + watchlist deltas |
| Watchlist storage | **Private store (SQLite)** keyed by `user_id` | Multi-user ready; never put watchlists in shared `market_data` |
| Instrument types | Stocks and mutual funds at minimum; indexes optional | Reuse track-beyond-seed identity rules (1.6) |
| Alerts | **In-app inbox only** in 1.22 | No email/SMS/push required |
| Tier B coupling | Watchlisted instruments are Tier B priority inputs | Wire to 1.21 priority API/hooks |
| Streamlit | Legacy; morning loop must not require it | Port workbook/CSV import into React if still Streamlit-only |
| Stance | Not computed here | Consume 1.23/1.24 when available |

---

## UX requirements (normative)

### Watchlists

- Create / rename / delete watchlist (at least one default “Watchlist” per user is acceptable).  
- Add/remove stock by symbol and fund by scheme identity already used in the app.  
- Open instrument detail from a watchlist row.  
- Honest empty: “No instruments yet” / “Not in catalog — add/track first” aligned with 1.6.  
- Optional: add-from-screener-row and add-from-detail-page actions.

### Morning inbox (Home)

Home must surface an **attention** section with, when data exists:

1. Portfolio summary strip — cost always; **MTM gain/loss when 1.11 is present**, else honest “not marked to market.”  
2. Watchlist highlights — e.g. large % move when Tier B/latest price exists; otherwise “price not synced.”  
3. Sync health — failed/stale jobs (builds on 1.4 `RecentSyncJobs` patterns).  
4. Stance flips — **only if** 1.23+ available; otherwise do not fake labels.

Beginner copy stays short; experienced users can expand sync details.

### React-only daily path

- Portfolio transaction/holdings import usable from React (feature parity enough for daily use).  
- Do not require opening Streamlit for the morning loop.

---

## Foundation

- [ ] SQLite (or portfolio DB) schema for `watchlists` + `watchlist_items` with unique (watchlist_id, instrument_key)  
- [ ] All watchlist APIs require authenticated user; users cannot read others’ lists  
- [ ] Watchlist instrument keys resolve through MarketResearch masters / track-beyond-seed  
- [ ] Tier B priority hook includes watchlist instrument IDs (1.21)  
- [ ] Home attention API or aggregated payload avoids N+1 quote fetches (batch latest prices/NAV)

## Out of scope

- Push/email alerts, price alert rules engine  
- Buy/hold/avoid computation  
- Saved screener definitions (can be Later)  
- Broker sync  
- Live trading  
- Multi-country instruments  

---

## Exit

A signed-in user can maintain a watchlist, see Home attention items for portfolio/watchlist/sync, and complete morning check without Streamlit. Watchlisted symbols participate in Tier B priority.

---

## Agent planning instructions

1. Implement watchlists in **Portfolio module** (private DB), not in `market_data`.  
2. Reuse existing instrument identity from 1.6; do not invent a parallel symbol table.  
3. If 1.11 is not done, still ship watchlists + sync attention; show honest non-MTM portfolio copy.  
4. Do not block 1.22 on Stance.  
5. Prefer TanStack Query patterns already used in `frontend-react`.  
6. One issue per checkbox; milestone `1.22`.  
7. Update 1.21 priority docs if hook names change.
